current_role: Prime Minister of Italy (since October 2022); president of Brothers of Italy
summary: Giorgia Meloni is Italy's first woman prime minister and heads its longest-serving postwar government. She came up through the youth wings of the neo-fascist MSI and post-fascist National Alliance, co-founded Brothers of Italy in 2012 and won the 2022 election. She opened Yoram Hazony's NatCon in Rome in February 2020 ("God, Honor, Country"). The only EU leader at Trump's second inauguration, she clashed with him from April 2026.
